title: Can a script on your page read the login cookie? If HttpOnly is off, any XSS can copy the session and act as that user. Check DevTools → App
content_md:
Can a script on your page read the login cookie? If HttpOnly is off, any XSS can copy the session and act as that user. Check DevTools → App

via Mastodon https://abbilabs.xyz/tips/httponly-secure-session-cookies
